## How this was tested

List the commands you ran and the scenarios you exercised. For UI changes,

-->

- [ ] `npm run lint`

- [ ] `npm run build`
- [ ] `npm run test:e2e` (when the change affects UI or browser behavior)

## Checklist

- [ ] The change stays local-first: no new server, account, telemetry, or upload path.
- [ ] Public behavior and exported APIs are documented.
- [ ] New logic has tests, and regressions are covered by a test.
- [ ] Keyboard navigation and screen-reader behavior were considered for UI changes.
- [ ] Color-meaning changes do not rely on color alone and meet WCAG 2.2 AA contrast.
- [ ] No secrets, private datasets, or generated build output were committed.
- [ ] Commits use Conventional Commits and are signed off with `git commit -s` (DCO).
